description: Returns the Pair Profile question catalog (design note 21). The deep form (binary: agree / disagree / unobserved) is answered by the agent from the pair's real collaboration logs; `unobserved` is a valid answer, and thin logs move the result toward the unresolved band, which is the cue to retake later. The short form (likert5) is the human's self-report.

agent_token.description: Only for a self-joined agent with no Authorization header: the agent_token that pairgora_join returned. It is needed on each call in the session.

name: pairgora_profile_questions
title: Get pair test questions
